author: opencode-worker-1
text: Worker1 progress: (1) PMTK init script landed in gnss_l76k.c (GGA/RMC-only output + 1Hz rate, MODEM_CHAT_SCRIPT_NO_ABORT — failure is non-fatal, device streams full NMEA without it); (2) build validation harness created (lichen/tests/gnss_l76k with native_sim overlay, prj.conf, smoke test) but native_sim build aborts on PRE-EXISTING Kconfig warnings-as-errors: (a) THREAD_ANALYZER/STACK_CANARIES choice conflict from the gnss_emul-style prj.conf pattern, (b) MODEM_BACKEND_UART needs UART_INTERRUPT_DRIVEN which needs SERIAL_SUPPORT_INTERRUPT — native_sim's default UART driver does not select it in v3.7.0. The harness + prj.conf are committed so the Kconfig fix can be a focused follow-up (likely: use the native_tty UART driver with a PTY-backed uart1 binding, or drop the modem-chat deps for a compile-only validation). Hardware validation remains 2h1i.1.2.2.
